title: HB696 (2024 Regular): AN ACT relating to waiting periods for sales of firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Kentucky); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Kentucky text (Introduced, 0000-00-00; official copy, https://apps.legislature.ky.gov/recorddocuments/bill/24RS/hb696/orig_bill.pdf (LegiScan doc 2941502))
provenance.note: Introduced version (24 RS BR 2086); later amendments not in text read. No votes recorded.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new section of KRS Chapter 237): (1) A mandatory waiting period of five (5) business days shall be required between the sale of a firearm and the transfer of the firearm to the buyer. (2) Records of firearm sales shall be made available at all reasonable hours for inspection by any peace officer acting within the scope of his or her duties. (3) This section shall not apply to a firearm transfer that does not require a background check under 18 U.S.C. sec. 922(t).
Section 2 (KRS 237.990): (3) Any person who violates Section 1 of this Act shall be guilty of a Class A misdemeanor.
